ms.promise:
Concept Report describing the Music Video Festival (MVF) concept.
 The report will include key categories summarizing the overall plan and vision for the event:
・Planning: Objectives, structure, and timeline for the festival.
・Guidelines: Competition rules, submission criteria, and ticketing workflow.
・Marketing: Strategies, asset needs, and social media engagement plan.
・Partnerships & Prizes: Collaboration opportunities and award structures.
・Best Practices & Future Planning: Learnings from similar events and plans for sustaining the MVF annually.

ms.report:
A. Output: Final Close-Out Report covering delivered activities and outputs, results and performance indicators, stakeholder and community engagement, lessons learned, and recommendations for future editions.
Acceptance criteria: Report completed in full compliance with Catalyst guidelines, with a publicly accessible link submitted. Achieved — the report is finalised and openly accessible.
Evidence: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1v7WWNB2WvUzVYPaB5W2Elyod3CM33FkjGdNFhSbo-IA/edit?usp=sharing
B. Output: Final Close-Out Video documenting key festival moments and highlights, artist participation, stakeholder involvement, and overall project impact.
Acceptance criteria: Video produced in compliance with Catalyst PCV requirements and uploaded to a public platform with unrestricted access. Achieved — published on YouTube with unrestricted access. The video also includes a demonstration of the end-to-end festival flow.
Evidence: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jqXDqp17jA0
C. Output: Organisation and official launch of the yearly Music Video Festival, delivered across five components: artist submissions (C1), ticketing and Web3 voting platform (C2), real-time support and engagement (C3), marketing activities (C4), and prizes and awards (C5).
C1 — Artist Submissions
 Acceptance criteria: Minimum of 30 artists submit entries; all accepted submissions publicly published on the festival website. Achieved — 32 submissions received and 31 accepted. One entry was removed because the video file was never submitted. All 31 accepted videos are published on the festival website.
 Evidence: Festival website with published submissions: https://musicvideofest.nucast.io/ · FilmFreeway event page: https://filmfreeway.com/MusicVIdeoFest2026 · Submissions can be viewed on the nucast site along with the artist socials: https://musicvideofest.nucast.io/
